assessment: This important paper solidly demonstrates that the gap junction protein GJA1 localizes to motile cilia and is required for the formation of motile cilia on the developing frog epidermis. In addition, GJA1 localizes to the peri-centrosomal region of primary cilia where it is proposed to participate in Rab8-Rab11 delivery of ciliary cargo. These findings point to new functions for gap junction proteins and raise important questions about the role of Gja1 in ciliary assembly and function.
